verdict.rationale: WorkOS first-party materials list passkeys and Magic Auth as built-in AuthKit sign-in methods alongside passwords, social login and SSO, delivered through a single integration. Its homepage also describes passwordless sign-in via a six-digit code sent by email, which covers the email OTP option. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on passkey/WebAuthn setup and APIs, evidence of clickable magic links (only email codes are shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
